pillars.title: Decent Work and Fair Pay
pillars.text: Fair wages, safe conditions, reasonable workloads, and dignified employment for every healthcare worker.

pillars.title: Rights & Protection
pillars.text: Defending healthcare workers from discrimination, harassment, intimidation, and unfair treatment.

pillars.title: Quality Care & Safety
pillars.text: Fighting for the staffing, resources, and standards needed for safe, quality healthcare.

pillars.title: Voice, Recognition & Growth
pillars.text: Ensuring healthcare workers are heard in policies and decisions that affect their work, while promoting professional recognition, career progression, development, and equal opportunity.

whyJoin.title: Case support
whyJoin.text: Confidential advice and formal representation whenever you face a workplace issue — free for every member.

whyJoin.title: Collective bargaining
whyJoin.text: We negotiate directly with health authorities on your behalf so individual voices become one strong demand.

whyJoin.title: Professional growth
whyJoin.text: CPD credits, scholarships and a growing library of clinical and career resources for every specialty.

heroSubtext: Maldives Health Professionals Union is the labour federation representing and advocating for the rights, welfare, and professional interests of both local and expatriate healthcare workers, including professional and support cadres, working across the Maldives.
